## Label
Immediately after submitting your Pull request make sure to post `/build` as a comment. This adds the `build` label and enable checks to continue.
If check fails before you add the label, you can restart the check by adding and removing the `build` label manually

## Checklist before your work can be merged
- [ ] I'm ONLY doing changes to the GitHub workflow (`.github/`), the repository main `README.md`, and/or the repository documentation (`docs/`)
- [ ] I've added the `build` label to my PR!
